transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Member Services. My name is Jordan. Who do I have the pleasure of speaking with today?

Customer: Hi Jordan, my name is Cal Hendricks. I'm looking at my recent card activity and there's something off with a gym charge.

Agent: Hello, Mr. Hendricks. I'd be glad to look into that for you. For security, could you please confirm your home zip code and the last four digits of your card?

Customer: Sure, the zip code is 84010, and the last four are 3319.

Agent: Thank you for confirming that. Which merchant is the charge from, and roughly when did it post?

Customer: It's from IronGate Fitness, around late September.

Agent: I see a transaction from IronGate Fitness on September 24th. Could you tell me a bit more about what happened with this?

Customer: Yeah, so I decided to finally join a gym because they had this special promo running for thirty-nine dollars a month. I signed up in person, but when I saw my card balance, they charged me roughly double what they promised.

Agent: When you signed up for the membership, did you sign a contract or receive an agreement with the thirty-nine dollar pricing?

Customer: Yes, I filled out the paperwork on their tablet and they sent me an email welcome packet that lists the thirty-nine dollar promotional monthly rate right at the top.

Agent: Have you had a chance to speak with anyone at IronGate Fitness regarding the higher charge?

Customer: I stopped by the front desk earlier this week and showed them, but the person working there had no idea what to do. They told me a manager would give me a call back, but I haven't heard a peep from them.

Agent: Did they offer to adjust the charge or give you any explanation for why it was so much higher than thirty-nine dollars?

Customer: No, the guy just took my phone number down on a sticky note and said management handles all the membership fee stuff.

Agent: Okay, let me make sure I have all the details noted correctly. You joined IronGate Fitness under a thirty-nine dollar monthly promotion, but on September 24th, you were charged approximately twice that amount, and the gym has not returned your calls or corrected it. Is that accurate?

Customer: Yes, exactly. That's the whole situation.
